EMAIL_CENTER.TITLE: Email Center
EMAIL_CENTER.DESC: Configure sender profiles, persona-based routing, recipient builders, and bilingual workflow previews.

AUDIENCE.TITLE: Persona-aware workflow coverage
AUDIENCE.DESC: Switch between super admin, vendor, driver, and customer routing scenarios.

SENDER_PROFILES.TITLE: Operational sender stack
SENDER_PROFILES.DESC: Reusable from-address identities for admin notifications and operational workflows.

PROFILES.SYSTEM_NO_REPLY: Automated sender for OTP, password reset, verification, and system-only messages.
PROFILES.PUBLIC_CONTACT: Public contact sender for contact-form responses and general correspondence.
PROFILES.OPS_PRIMARY: Primary sender for platform-wide operational and access messages.
PROFILES.RISK_DESK: Dedicated sender for risk, compliance, and escalation workflows.
PROFILES.VENDOR_NETWORK: Dedicated sender for vendor network onboarding, branch access, and routing updates.
PROFILES.FINANCE_DIGEST: Finance-safe sender for settlement summaries and reconciliation digests.

WORKFLOWS.TITLE: Persona-based email workflows
WORKFLOWS.DESC: Review enabled rules, audience scope, sender profile, and routing strategy from one place.
WORKFLOWS.NO_MATCH_DESC: Try a different search term or change the audience filter.

RULE_DETAIL.TITLE: Rule details
RULE_DETAIL.SUBTITLE: Configure routing, template, and recipients for this workflow rule.

EMAIL_CENTER.RULE_NOT_FOUND: The requested email rule could not be found.

TEMPLATE.TITLE: Bind the email template to this rule
TEMPLATE.DESC: Edit subject, body, hero image, and CTA with a live preview that matches backend rendering.
TEMPLATE.VARIABLES_HINT: Click any variable to append it to the template body.
TEMPLATE.PREVIEW_ERROR: Could not load the template preview from backend.

DELIVERY.TITLE: Recipients and pre-send verification
DELIVERY.DESC: Review subject, variables, and resolved recipients before test send or live dispatch.

PERSONAS.TITLE: Persona targeting
PERSONAS.DESC: Limit each rule to the personas that should receive or influence the workflow.

RECIPIENTS.TITLE: Directory recipient targets
RECIPIENTS.DESC: Build To, CC, and BCC groups from access-directory identities instead of hardcoded emails.

STATIC_RECIPIENTS.TITLE: Manual recipients
STATIC_RECIPIENTS.DESC: Always include these fixed recipients in addition to directory-driven routing.

FALLBACK.TITLE: Fallback recipients
FALLBACK.DESC: Use fallback contacts when no directory target is resolved for the selected scope.

MESSAGES.SAVE_SUCCESS: Rule settings saved successfully and synced with the backend.
MESSAGES.TEST_SEND_SUCCESS: Test Send executed successfully and logged.

LOADING.TITLE: Loading email center
LOADING.DESC: Fetching workflow rules, sender profiles, and dispatch history from the backend.

HISTORY.TITLE: Recent email dispatches
HISTORY.DESC: Track test sends and live automation deliveries with backend-backed audit history.
HISTORY.EMPTY_DESC: No email dispatches match the current filters yet.

PREVIEW.TITLE: Live bilingual preview
PREVIEW.DESC: Review subjects, body copy, and dynamic variables without opening a template builder.
PREVIEW.SUBJECT: Subject
PREVIEW.NO_VARIABLES: No variables used in this template.

NOTES.ADMIN_INVITE: Send immediately when a new admin user is invited into the control center.
NOTES.ACCESS_RESET: Used when administrative access is reset or reissued.
NOTES.VENDOR_REVIEW: Routes new vendor review cases to the governance queue.
NOTES.DISPUTE_ESCALATION: Escalates SLA breaches and sensitive disputes to risk leadership.
NOTES.SETTLEMENT_DIGEST: Daily finance digest for payout, reconciliation, and blocked exposure review.
NOTES.SUPER_ADMIN_ACCESS_INVITE: Notify invited super admin identities and their owning managers when access is provisioned.
NOTES.VENDOR_BRANCH_INVITE: Trigger when a branch operator or branch manager receives a new vendor-panel invitation.
NOTES.BRANCH_PASSWORD_RESET: Used for secure reset and re-activation of vendor branch credentials.
NOTES.VENDOR_FINANCE_DIGEST: Delivers vendor payout, settlement, and balance summaries to finance stakeholders.
NOTES.DRIVER_VERIFICATION_UPDATE: Routes verification state updates for driver identities and compliance teams.
NOTES.DRIVER_PAYOUT_ALERT: Summarizes payout readiness, COD exposure, and balance movement for driver accounts.
NOTES.CUSTOMER_SUPPORT_ESCALATION: Alerts customer, support, and oversight teams when a high-touch support case escalates.
NOTES.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_RECOVERY: Secure recovery workflow for customer account access and follow-up support.
NOTES.CUSTOMER_ORDER_CONFIRMED: Sends only when an order is confirmed after payment/COD placement.
NOTES.CUSTOMER_ORDER_OUT_FOR_DELIVERY: Sends only when an order reaches OnTheWay status.
NOTES.CUSTOMER_DRIVER_ARRIVED_AT_DELIVERY: Sends only when the driver marks arrived at customer.
NOTES.CUSTOMER_ORDER_IMPORTANT_UPDATE: Sends only for major order/payment changes.
NOTES.VENDOR_WEEKLY_SUMMARY: Sends Mondays at 09:00 Asia/Riyadh when the vendor had order activity last week.
NOTES.VENDOR_APPROVED: Automatically dispatches when the vendor account is approved.
NOTES.VENDOR_PASSWORD_RESET: Automatically dispatches when a vendor password reset is triggered.
